question: Can four author-reported city attestations be joined to exact native inscription sections?
review_questions: Do the catalogue names and bibliographic locators support each candidate reference?
Can an exact section or line be established without assuming that a grouped dossier is one physical inscription?
Are the distinct uncertainty scopes preserved, and which source editions can be lawfully inspected next?
remaining_gates: Direct inspection of the cited inscription editions at the exact sections
Disambiguate catalogue grouping, aliases and section identifiers before any linguistic join
Independent epigraphic review of the author-reported assertions
